subject: Sentinel: fix regression requiring "+failover" ACL in failover path (#2780)
reason: The change is confined to Sentinel-mode code: sentinelSendReplicaOf in src/sentinel.c now sends FAILOVER ABORT in the reconfiguration MULTI only when the monitored instance's master_failover_state shows an ongoing failover, instead of whenever the instance supports that INFO field, so a sentinel ACL user without +failover no longer gets its SLAVEOF transaction aborted by a queue-time NOPERM. That code runs only inside a valkey-sentinel process during a failover it orchestrates.
